legacy_cohorts.note: Forward-only paper comparison: 100/0, 75/25, 50/50 (control), 25/75 probability/EV weights and adaptive evidence weights. All use the same frozen seven-market pool, 48-hour horizon, prices, costs and one-market-per-match policy cap (12 in v15; 10 in archived v14). Primary results include ALL selections, with STRICT/PROVISIONAL shown separately. First eligible usable capture per fixture only; no historical backfill or repeated stakes. Win rates include Wilson intervals. Profit differences pair each verified usable fixture with control, using one unit for a selection and zero if skipped. Weekly block bootstrap intervals are exploratory, unadjusted for four comparisons in v2 (three in legacy v1), and unavailable before six weeks/100 paired fixtures. Selection-cohort Brier scores do not prove improved forecasts. Readiness requires 300 verified usable fixtures, six ISO weeks, 80% resolved coverage and 100 settled picks per weighting. Adaptive probability weight ranges from 50% to 90%, using only frozen development support, development calibration penalties, raw model/reference disagreement and quote age. These bounds are a pre-registered hypothesis, not fitted optimal weights or a safety guarantee. Legacy v1 results remain a separate cohort; v2 readiness and paired returns use only contemporaneous v2 captures. No automatic production change. Confirm any chosen weighting on a later untouched period.
